column7: ADR-112 Amendment 5: the require_mfa grace start is written to system_metadata (adr112.require_mfa.grace_started) by the first graced boot and kept by every later boot, so the 30-day window is measured from the upgrade, not from the last restart; RequireMFA stays true during the grace period (the running server subtracts it). Past the deadline at boot: TestADR112MFAGrace_DeadlinePassedAtBoot (enforced, marker written); clock set back since the last boot: TestADR112MFAGrace_BackwardClockAtBootDoesNotExtend; corrupt values fail closed: TestADR112MFAGrace_CorruptFactsFailClosed. SQLite and, with KEYORIX_TEST_PG_DSN, PostgreSQL.
